summary: Backend-only verification of the invite-link base URL fix (APP_BASE_URL as source of truth). New suite /app/backend/tests/test_invite_baseurl.py (12 tests) — all pass. Confirmed POST /api/admin/invites always returns join_url = https://realestate-ai-flow.emergent.host/join/{code} even when a hostile Origin (random.example.com), Referer (referer.example.com) and origin_url payload (preview.example.com) are sent, proving the env var takes priority. GET /api/admin/invites returns join_url_prefix = '{APP_BASE_URL}/join'. invite_email() HTML renders the production URL and contains no preview host; one real Resend send to grelligram@gmail.com returned email_sent=true with the production join_url. Also curl-verified the production host is actually reachable (GET / -> 200, GET /join/inv_test -> 200), so shared links no longer hit 'site can't be reached'. Regression: test_admin_kb_rbac.py 45/45 pass; test_email_resend.py 17/17 pass (report email real send with DOCX attachment included; deselected only the duplicate invite real-send to respect the 1-2 email limit). Total 74 tests passed, 0 failed. All invites created during testing were revoked and the on-the-fly TEST_InviteCo company was deleted.

minor.issue: A company is created on-the-fly before the invite; DELETE /api/admin/invites/{code} does not remove that company, leaving orphan companies with no admin_user_id. Consider cleanup on revoke or lazy company creation at join time.

Inline imports (os, urllib.parse) inside the handler and duplicated base-URL resolution logic in create_invite and list_invites — extract a single helper (e.g. get_app_base_url(request)) to keep both endpoints in sync.
APP_BASE_URL is unvalidated at startup; if it were ever set to an empty/typo value the endpoint silently falls back to a relative '/join/{code}'. Log a startup warning when APP_BASE_URL is missing.

action_items: Optional: delete/avoid the auto-created company when an admin invite is revoked (orphan company records)
Optional: refactor duplicated APP_BASE_URL resolution into one helper and warn at startup if unset
Housekeeping: 2 orphan 'TEST_Sirket A.Ş.' companies from earlier iterations remain in DB (not created by this run)
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and effective: canonical_join_url is computed before the email branch, so the emailed link and the API response can never diverge; APP_BASE_URL wins over origin_url/Origin/Referer as intended.

Frontend wiring verified by code read only (backend-only request): SuperAdmin.jsx uses result.join_url for display+copy and invitePrefix for the list copy button; AdminPanel.jsx uses invitePrefix. window.location.origin remains only as a last-resort fallback, which is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded super_admin (test_super_admin_token) and user (test_session_seed_001). Created 4 invites + 1 company (TEST_InviteCo) — all deleted after the run; invites collection verified empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_invite_baseurl.py` from /app/backend — it performs exactly 1 real Resend send to grelligram@gmail.com. Do not loop it. APP_BASE_URL in backend/.env is the source of truth for join links; assert against it rather than hardcoding. test_email_resend.py also sends 2 real emails, deselect TestInviteEmail::test_invite_with_verified_email_real_send when re-running alongside the invite suite. Production host https://realestate-ai-flow.emergent.host is live (200).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: join links were built from the browser origin, which in the preview environment is the preview host that external invitees cannot reach. Fix verified: backend now derives the link from APP_BASE_URL (production host) with highest priority and returns join_url / join_url_prefix so the frontend never constructs the URL itself. Reproduced hostile-origin scenarios confirm the env value always wins.
